findings.title: Cron deletes past-due reminders before cancelling flagged ones
findings.body: The unconditional deleteMany of reminders with scheduledDate <= now runs before the cancellation lookup, and the cancel step only covers scheduledDate within the next hour. A cancelled reminder is only cancelled in SendGrid once it is inside that 1-hour window. If the cron is missed, or a booking is cancelled less than 15 minutes before the send, the row is deleted without the cancel call and the email still goes out. Cancel flagged rows before the cleanup, and make the cleanup skip them.

findings.title: One failed SendGrid call aborts all remaining cancellations and swallows the error
findings.body: The whole loop sits in a single try/catch. If client.request throws for one reminder, the loop exits and the deletions already queued in workflowRemindersToDelete are never awaited. Later reminders are skipped for this run. The Prisma deletes are also lazy promises that only execute at Promise.all. Handle errors per reminder. Also, remindersToCancel is not filtered by method, so SMS reminders flagged cancelled would be sent to SendGrid (SMS deletion currently deletes the row directly, so this is latent).

findings.title: client.setApiKey is never called in the cron module
findings.body: The cron handler now uses the @sendgrid/client `client`, but the file only calls sgMail.setApiKey. Authentication relies on emailReminderManager having been imported in the same process, which is not guaranteed. If the key is unset, the cancel requests fail with 401, and the error is swallowed by the catch.

findings.title: Reminders with no referenceId are deleted, but unscheduled ones may be sent later
findings.body: When referenceId is null, the row is simply deleted. This is right for unscheduled rows. In the non-immediate path, a reminder that was scheduled and flagged cancelled is only cancelled by the cron. The cron's 1-hour window means reminders flagged less than an hour before send depend on a 15-minute cron running successfully. There is no fallback if SendGrid cancellation fails, since the row is then left flagged until the date passes and gets deleted by the cleanup.

findings.title: Unrelated whitespace changes inside a commented-out block
findings.body: The diff strips indentation across the large commented-out testAction block. It is unrelated to the fix and adds noise to review and blame.

findings.title: Unrelated UI change removes sender ID rendering inside the phone block
findings.body: This change is unrelated to the PR's stated purpose. The wrapper condition changes from (isPhoneNumberNeeded || isSenderIdNeeded) to isPhoneNumberNeeded only. The sender section is separately rendered below, so the visible effect should be neutral, but it is an unexplained refactor mixed into a bug fix.
